label: Name Auctions
description: Open, bid, reveal, register, and manage Fistbump names.

methods.name: sendopen
methods.description: Open an auction for a Fistbump name. Subdomain names (containing dots) are auto-detected.

params.name: name
params.description: The name to open an auction for.

params.name: domain
params.description: ICANN domain for DNSSEC proof (required for premium names ≤6 bytes). Must have a _fbd TXT record containing fbd=<name>:<address>.

methods.notes: Names ≤6 bytes are premium and require a DNSSEC proof. Set a TXT record at _fbd.<domain> with value fbd=<name>:<your-fbd-address>, then pass the domain. Non-premium names are released on a 60-day rollout schedule. Subdomain names (e.g., "example.fistbump") are auto-detected: the parent must exist on-chain and have allowSubdomains enabled.

methods.name: sendbid
methods.description: Place a blind bid on a name auction.

params.name: lockup
params.description: Total lockup amount in FBC (must be >= bid). The difference is the blind.

params.name: domain
params.description: ICANN domain for DNSSEC proof (required for premium names ≤6 bytes).

methods.notes: Lockup must be >= bid. The difference is the blind. Name must be in BIDDING state. Premium names (≤6 bytes) require a DNSSEC domain proof. Subdomain names are auto-detected and validated against the parent.

methods.name: sendreveal

params.name: name
params.description: The name to reveal bids for.

methods.notes: Name must be in REVEAL state.

methods.name: sendredeem
methods.description: Redeem a losing reveal to reclaim locked funds.

params.name: name
params.description: The name to redeem losing bids for.

methods.notes: Name must be in CLOSED state.

methods.name: sendregister
methods.description: Register a won name. Optionally set DNS records.
methods.notes: Must own the winning reveal. For subdomain names, the registration fee is split: 50% burned, 25% to ancestor name owners, 25% to the development fund.

methods.name: sendupdate
methods.description: Update DNS records and/or flags for an owned name.

params.name: flags
params.description: Name flags: {"auctionSubdomains": true}. Once enabled, auctionSubdomains cannot be disabled.

methods.notes: Name must be in CLOSED state. To enable subdomains, pass flags: {"auctionSubdomains": true}. This flag is permanent and cannot be unset. Names with auctionSubdomains cannot set delegation records (NS, DS, GLUE4, GLUE6, SYNTH4, SYNTH6). Existing delegation records must be removed before enabling subdomains.

methods.name: sendrenew
methods.notes: Name must be in CLOSED state.

methods.name: sendtransfer
methods.description: Start a name transfer to another address.
methods.notes: Name must be in CLOSED state.

methods.name: sendfinalize
methods.notes: Transfer lockup period must have elapsed.

methods.name: sendrevoke
methods.description: Revoke a name, burning its value permanently.
methods.notes: Scorched earth measure. Permanently burns the name and its locked value. Use during the transfer lockup period to prevent a stolen name from being finalized. You lose the name and the coins, but the attacker gets nothing. After ~7 days the name reopens for auction.
